comment: Catalog of language packages this app can install. Sizes are rough ESTIMATES. downloadUrl is intentionally empty: this project does not host runtime archives. Set downloadUrl (https) and sha256 for an archive you trust, or install a local .zip.

packages.name: Python 3
packages.notes: Must be built for Android (bionic libc) and be relocatable. Termux packages are built for the com.termux prefix and will NOT work unmodified.
guide: Build or obtain a CPython build for android arm64 that runs from any install directory.
Add runtime.json at the archive root (see docs/RUNTIME_PACKAGES.md, example in docs/examples/python-runtime.json).
Zip it, then tap 'Install file' or 'Import .zip archive'.
Open a .py file and press Run.

packages.name: PHP CLI
packages.notes: Needs a statically linked or relocatable php-cli built for Android. Runs scripts via the CLI; no web server is included.
guide: Obtain a php-cli binary built for android arm64.
Place it in bin/ and write runtime.json (docs/RUNTIME_PACKAGES.md).
Zip and install, then Run a .php file.

packages.name: OpenJDK (javac + java)
packages.notes: Needs a JDK built for Android/bionic. Compiles with javac then runs the class named after the file (no package support in the default run steps).
guide: Obtain an OpenJDK build for android arm64.
Write runtime.json with javac and java steps (docs/examples/java-runtime.json).
Zip and install, then Run Main.java.

packages.name: Clang (C and C++)
packages.notes: Needs an on-device clang toolchain plus sysroot/headers. This is the largest package.
guide: Obtain a clang toolchain that runs on android arm64 with a sysroot.
Write runtime.json with compile and run steps (docs/examples/clang-runtime.json).
Zip and install, then Run a .c or .cpp file.
